recognize_zh: 這是 inverse PCR 洋菜膠電泳圖，非形態學影像：移植前檢體（lane 1–3）在約 234 bp 處可見代表主要 ATL 克隆的 HTLV-1 前病毒整合位點條帶，移植後檢體（lane 4–6）完全無條帶，表示克隆偵測不到。
features: Agarose gel electrophoresis of inverse PCR for HTLV-1 proviral integration sites
Lanes 1-3 (before BMT) show discrete bands, with the major clone band at approximately 234 bp
Lanes 1 and 3 show additional larger bands (about 300-400 bp), indicating additional integration sites or minor clones
Lanes 4-6 (after BMT) show no amplified bands
Size ladder on right spanning 194 to 1353 bp
describe_en: This figure is an ethidium bromide-stained agarose gel of inverse PCR detecting HTLV-1 proviral integration sites as a marker of the ATL cell clone. Pre-transplant samples (lanes 1-3) show discrete bands, with a major clone band at approximately 234 bp and additional bands in the 300-400 bp range, indicating clonal integration of the provirus. Post-transplant samples (lanes 4-6) show no detectable bands, consistent with eradication of the ATL clone below the assay detection limit after bone marrow transplantation. This is molecular data without morphologic content; absence of bands should be interpreted in light of assay sensitivity and DNA quality controls.
